promptTranslations.en: a planet from orbit, terrain, oceans, drifting clouds, day/night terminator with city lights, atmosphere at the limb, slow rotation, drag to tilt, a "Season" button that shifts the ice caps.
promptTranslations.zh: 从轨道俯瞰的行星，地形，海洋，飘移的云层，带有城市灯光的晨昏线，行星边缘的大气层，缓慢自转，拖动以倾斜，一个可改变极地冰盖的 "Season" 按钮。
promptTranslations.zh-TW: 從軌道俯瞰的行星，地形，海洋，飄移的雲層，帶有城市燈光的晨昏線，行星邊緣的大氣層，緩慢自轉，拖動以傾斜，一個可改變極地冰蓋的 "Season" 按鈕。
promptTranslations.ja-JP: 軌道上から見た惑星、地形、海洋、漂う雲、街の明かりが見える昼夜の境界線（明暗境界線）、縁の大気、ゆっくりとした自転、ドラッグして傾ける操作、氷冠を移動させる "Season" ボタン。
promptTranslations.ko-KR: 궤도에서 본 행성, 지형, 바다, 흘러가는 구름, 도시 불빛이 보이는 낮/밤 명암 경계선, 가장자리 대기, 느린 자전, 드래그하여 기울이기, 극지방 빙하를 변화시키는 "Season" 버튼.
promptTranslations.th-TH: ดาวเคราะห์มองจากวงโคจร, ภูมิประเทศ, มหาสมุทร, เมฆที่ล่องลอย, เส้นแบ่งกลางวัน/กลางคืนพร้อมแสงไฟของเมือง, บรรยากาศบริเวณขอบดาวเคราะห์, การหมุนอย่างช้าๆ, ลากเพื่อเอียง, ปุ่ม "Season" ที่เปลี่ยนการปกคลุมของพืดน้ำแข็ง.
promptTranslations.vi-VN: một hành tinh nhìn từ quỹ đạo, địa hình, đại dương, mây trôi, đường ranh giới ngày/đêm với ánh đèn thành phố, bầu khí quyển ở rìa, chuyển động quay chậm, kéo để nghiêng, một nút "Season" làm thay đổi các chỏm băng.
promptTranslations.hi-IN: कक्षा से देखा गया एक ग्रह, भूभाग, महासागर, बहते बादल, शहर की बत्तियों के साथ दिन/रात की विभाजक रेखा, क्षितिज पर वायुमंडल, धीमा घूर्णन, झुकाने के लिए खींचें, एक "Season" बटन जो बर्फ की चोटियों को बदलता है।
promptTranslations.es-ES: un planeta visto desde la órbita, terreno, océanos, nubes a la deriva, terminador día/noche con luces de ciudades, atmósfera en el limbo, rotación lenta, arrastrar para inclinar, un botón "Season" que desplaza los casquetes polares.
promptTranslations.es-419: un planeta visto desde la órbita, terreno, océanos, nubes a la deriva, terminador día/noche con luces de ciudades, atmósfera en el limbo, rotación lenta, arrastrar para inclinar, un botón "Season" que desplaza los casquetes polares.
promptTranslations.de-DE: ein Planet aus dem Orbit, Gelände, Ozeane, ziehende Wolken, Tag-Nacht-Terminator mit Lichtern von Städten, Atmosphäre am Rand, langsame Rotation, ziehen zum Neigen, eine Schaltfläche "Season", die die Eiskappen verschiebt.
promptTranslations.fr-FR: une planète vue depuis l'orbite, relief, océans, nuages dérivants, terminateur jour/nuit avec les lumières des villes, atmosphère sur le limbe, rotation lente, faire glisser pour incliner, un bouton "Season" qui déplace les calottes glaciaires.
promptTranslations.it-IT: un pianeta dall'orbita, rilievi, oceani, nuvole alla deriva, terminatore giorno/notte con le luci delle città, atmosfera al bordo, rotazione lenta, trascina per inclinare, un pulsante "Season" che sposta le calotte polari.
promptTranslations.pt-BR: um planeta visto da órbita, terreno, oceanos, nuvens à deriva, terminador dia/noite com luzes da cidade, atmosfera no limbo, rotação lenta, arraste para inclinar, um botão "Season" que altera as calotas de gelo.

promptTranslations.tr-TR: yörüngeden bir gezegen, arazi, okyanuslar, sürüklenen bulutlar, şehir ışıklarıyla gündüz/gece aydınlanma çemberi, kenarda atmosfer, yavaş dönüş, eğmek için sürükleme, buzulları değiştiren bir "Season" düğmesi.

post.originalText:
Grok 4.7 vs 4.6, but not another Three.js scene: one GLSL fragment shader, no libraries, no CDN. Pure math to pixels.

Prompt: a planet from orbit, terrain, oceans, drifting clouds, day/night terminator with city lights, atmosphere at the limb, slow rotation, drag to tilt, a "Season" button that shifts the ice caps.

Nothing to copy from a tutorial. Noise, lighting and atmosphere have to be composed correctly or it's mud.

4.6: 353 s · 23.1K tokens (17.7K thinking) · 12.4 KB
4.7: 723 s · 54.4K tokens (48.5K thinking) · 14.1 KB

Both compiled first try, zero repairs. 4.7: sharper coastlines, visible atmosphere ring, labeled season cycle. 4.6: softer surface, warmer terminator glow.

 Try them:
 https://t.co/bSr5TmRPAb
 https://t.co/9IneKLFilI
